create_rocbert_config: create a RoCBertConfig instance with default weiweishi/roc-bert-base-zh style configuration
initialize_rocbert_model: initialize a RoCBertModel from a RoCBertConfig instance
configure_rocbert_pronunciation: configure RoCBertConfig to enable or disable pronunciation embeddings
configure_rocbert_shape: configure RoCBertConfig to enable or disable shape embeddings
configure_rocbert_concat_input: configure RoCBertConfig to merge embeddings via concatenation or averaging
